verdict.rationale: jo's homepage says you can give it 'a job and a schedule' to get recurring outputs like a weekly plan, morning priorities, or a weekend task review without asking each time. The llms.txt adds that it works overnight on its own always-on machine and prepares recurring briefings. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how schedules are set (cadence options, editing or cancelling jobs, multi-step workflow chaining), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled jobs run reliably.
